title: Cell Culture and UV Cross-Linking
author: Clémentine elan-Forino
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bntemeje

steps.title: Streak strains on plates
steps.instruction: Streak HTP‑tagged and negative‑control strains from glycerol stocks onto YPD plates (or SD medium with leucine if plasmid maintenance is required) and incubate at 30 °C for 48–76 hours.

steps.title: Inoculate starter cultures
steps.instruction: Pick single colonies and inoculate each into 5 mL SD medium (YNB‑amino acids, CSM‑TRP, 2 % glucose); incubate at 30 °C with shaking at 200 rpm for 6 hours. Use these starter cultures to inoculate 100 mL overnight cultures.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL SD medium and incubate 30 °C, 200 rpm, 6 h.
Transfer appropriate volume to 100 mL fresh SD medium for overnight growth.

steps.title: Scale up to large culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 2.75 L pre‑warmed minimal medium with enough overnight culture to obtain an initial OD₆₀₀ ≈ 0.05; grow with shaking until OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.5.

steps.title: Prepare UV cross‑linker
steps.instruction: Clean the UV cross‑linker with deionized water before use and pre‑warm the lamp.

steps.title: UV cross‑link cells
steps.instruction: Irradiate the cultures in the UV cross‑linker at room temperature for 1 minute 40 seconds (254 nm, average dose ≈ 1.6 mJ cm⁻²).

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pour the irradiated cultures into pre‑chilled 1 L centrifuge bottles on ice and centrifuge at 2700 × g, 4 °C for 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cultures to pre‑chilled 1 L bottles on ice.

steps.title: Wash and re‑centrifuge pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 30 mL ice‑cold phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS), transfer to a 50 mL Falcon tube, and centrifuge at 3000 × g, 4 °C for 5 minutes. Keep the three pellets in separate tubes; one will be used per CRAC experiment.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 30 mL ice‑cold PBS.
Transfer suspension to a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Store cell pellets
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and store the washed pellets at –80 °C until needed.
